title: Carrier and inclusion comparisons for powered pullback
statement: For the explicit powered pullback of [def-zl-powered-geometric-pullback], the composite of its all-proetale version with the carrier forgetful functor is canonically isomorphic to ordinary adic inverse image after forgetting the source structure. Its restriction to constructible Weil sheaves commutes, by a canonical natural isomorphism, with their full-subcategory inclusions.
